about: The household's money at the start of the game (docs/LIFE_SYSTEMS.md 3a, Step 1). Starting balances are tuning. The mortgage loan is from docs/FAMILY.md. Debts are positive numbers (what is owed). The overdraft fills when the joint account would go below £0; a full overdraft means the rest of a bill is not paid.

stocks.about: Starts at null: the code works out the balance on the game's start date from the loan below.

mortgage.source: docs/FAMILY.md, Home and mortgage: £238,500 loan, about 4.6% fixed, 25-year term. These are assumptions, not a lender's offer. The first payment date (1 May 2024) is tuning.

salary.about: Tom's salary and pension (user choice, 2026-11-11). The 5% is taken from his whole salary: the simplification is that the auto-enrolment qualifying-earnings band is not used.
